name: Distracting Charge [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your charge exposes an opening your ally can exploit.

Benefit(s): When you use the charge action and hit, your allies gain a +2 bonus on their next attack roll against the target of that charge. This bonus must be used before your next turn, or it is lost.
